===The Things We Do For Love===
{{Checklist|
'''Items Required:''' [[Trollweiss]], Food, Armour, and a Weapon.''
*Return to [[Ug]].
'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' Arrg will attack '''immediately''' after the next step, using a combination of <u>melee</u> AND <u>ranged</u> attacks that can hit in the 30s, so be prepared!
*Talk to [[Arrg]]. {{Chat option|1I am here to kill you!}} He will teleport you into the arena.
*Kill Arrg.
::Arrg can de-spawn if not killed fast enough using the safe-spot, so killing him could be difficult on a low level account.
*Return to Ug.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
